motions.label: Programmed stones · 20 mm
motions.description: 0.4 m/s command · 20 mm fixed rounded stones. Crosses all 10 stones and settles; passes at both timesteps.
motions.limit_text: Current V2 with explicit rotor dynamics. Programmed feedback with perfect robot state, no terrain lookahead. One terrain seed; general off-road and hardware capability remain unqualified.

report.scope: Programmed 500 Hz feedback with perfect robot state; no terrain-map input. Single course and nominal initial state; not learned or hardware-qualified.
limitations: Unweighed CAD/component-prior masses; current more-detailed left hip and earlier right hip retained.
Ground contacts use outer CAD convex hulls and rigid 120x20 mm tire cylinders. No self-contact or TPU deformation; recovery is not qualified by this plant.
Hip and wheel currents, voltage, DC-equivalent conventions, efficiencies and rotor inertias require identification. 32 A hip propeller-cooled rating does not qualify sealed duty.
Guide friction uses preceding-step transverse joint reaction; coefficient, one-step delay and damping are explicit unmeasured priors.
No backlash, structural flex, thermal limits, real battery/regeneration model, estimator delay or learned policy yet.

Explicit rotor/gear bodies with ideal gear equalities and equivalent output torques. Unmeasured hip rotor split and illustrative wheel rotor CAD; no backlash, tooth compliance or identified internal inertia.
Fixed heightfield stones and grades; no loose material. Turning/reversing, random starts, hardware variations and general off-road qualification are separate tests.

motions.label: Programmed stones · 30 mm · blocked
motions.description: 0.4 m/s command · 30 mm fixed rounded stones. Blocked trial: the shin case contacts a stone. Route and stopping checks fail.
motions.limit_text: Current V2 with explicit rotor dynamics. Programmed feedback with perfect robot state, no terrain lookahead. One terrain seed; general off-road and hardware capability remain unqualified. The encoder-cap collision shape needs refinement; this blocked trial is not proof of a hardware limit.
